# Historical candidate generator

`candidates.py.txt` is the exact historical generator recorded by the antibody
variant example manifests (SHA-256 `172de2178061667133bf83e105b8be81491a5c09367a06dd85acd344d13fcb37`).
It is retained as evidence of which source produced those examples; it is not
an executable entry point. New runs record the hash of the current generator.
